messages:
jamal: quick check  we need a compact contract for exposing when we downgrade outputs (degrade vs full reject). do we prefer a terse header or a small body field for cross-proxy compatibility?
elaine: terse header preferred for gateways + metrics. body fallback ok for older clients. suggest one canonical header: `x-rwi-deg` with semicolon-delimited attrs: `reason=quota;retry=1;delay_ms=800;fb=llama-quant`. header stays <= 128 chars.
omar: +1 for single header. but please avoid freeform model names in headers, security will yell. keep fallback tokenized e.g., `fb=lm-qa-v2` (opaque token).
nina: status code debate: i'd rather not invent new 4xx. we can use 206 (Partial Content) for soft-degrade when part of response is synthesized vs cached, and 429 for rate/quota. 5xx reserved for infra. open to alternatives.
security: reminder: headers are network-visible. no tenant ids, no long traces. model tokens okay if opaque and documented. also need consent for any PII in body fallback fields.
jamal: ok re model naming — runtime will emit opaque fallback token; telemetry maps token -> model variant internally.
elaine: SDK work: SDKs should expose a DegradeSignal {reason, retryable, suggestedDelayMs, fallbackToken} and surface both when thrown and on response metadata for non-exceptional soft-degrade. sample JS API:
```
const r = await client.generate(...)
if (r.degradeSignal) console.warn(r.degradeSignal.reason)
```
and in error: `throw new DegradedError(degradeSignal)`
omar: console UX: proposal for a compact row-level indicator on routes: green/yellow/red where yellow=0.5%-3% degrades last 30m, red=>3%. tooltip text should be actionable: e.g. "3.2% degraded: quota spikes during batch job window. Retryable: yes (see suggested delay)."
nina: telemetry sampling: start at 0.5% global, 10% for internal tenants, 50% for canary customers. include a way to force-sample via opt-in flag per-tenant.
jamal: runbook: create `degrade-minor` and `degrade-major` steps. minor = automatic alert w/ oncall notify, major = page SRE + product + eng-platform. nina please draft.
nina: will do. also add CI smoke that asserts SDK can parse `x-rwi-deg` header for all languages. ci-bot can you add a job?
ci-bot: CI job created: sdk/header-parsing-smoke -> runs on PRs touching sdk/* and runtime/*; schedule: immediate.
security: also add a data-retention policy for degrade telemetry events (keep 90d default). avoid long-term storage of detailed rollout traces unless explicitly approved.
jamal: timeline: aim to dark-launch header-only internal canary next week (feature flag on), body fallback for legacy clients in week 2, console badge in week 3. who owns feature flag?
elainE: typo (elaine): i'll own the flag and rollout toggles. will coordinate with infra for rollout gating.
omar: i'll prepare the console mock and PR for thresholds copy.
jamal: action items: 1) runtime to implement `x-rwi-deg` per spec (omar/elaine); 2) SDK team to add DegradeSignal and smoke tests (nina); 3) security to sign off on header tokenization and retention (security); 4) runbook + alerts (nina). aim to have PRs by Thu EOD.
elaine: i'll open the header contract PR today with examples and limits.
nina: creating runbook and CI PR now.
security: will review PRs and add comments within 24h.
jamal: great. ping me if blockers. thanks all.
